name: pdf-linter
install: . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm install "$(cat .node-version)" && nvm use "$(cat .node-version)" && export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which current)"):$PATH" && node -v && npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

terminals.name: dev-server
terminals.command: . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" && nvm use "$(cat .node-version)" && export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which current)"):$PATH" && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
